onboarding.step1.title: Welcome to JW Notes Sync
onboarding.step1.desc: This app lets you merge JW Library backups from multiple devices into one file — without losing any notes, highlights, or bookmarks.
onboarding.step2.title: Import your backups
onboarding.step2.desc: Drop your .jwlibrary files or browse to select them. You can also try our sample data to see how it works.
onboarding.step3.title: Merge & download
onboarding.step3.desc: Choose a merge strategy, preview the result, and download a single merged .jwlibrary file ready to import on any device.
onboarding.step4.title: Your data stays private
onboarding.step4.desc: Everything runs in your browser. No data is ever sent to a server. Your notes remain yours.
help.title: Help & FAQ
help.faq.what.a: It's a backup file exported from JW Library. It contains all your notes, highlights, bookmarks, tags, and playlists in a ZIP archive with a SQLite database.
help.faq.how.q: How do I export a backup from JW Library?
help.faq.how.a: In JW Library, go to the hamburger menu → Backup & Restore → Back Up Data. Choose a location to save the .jwlibrary file.
help.faq.import.q: How do I import the merged file back?
help.faq.import.a: In JW Library, go to Backup & Restore → Restore. Select the merged .jwlibrary file. Note: this will replace your current data with the merged version.
help.faq.privacy.a: Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser. No data is uploaded to any server. The source code is open on GitHub for anyone to verify.
help.faq.devices.q: Can I merge more than 2 devices?
help.faq.devices.a: Currently, you can merge 2 backups at a time. To merge 3+ devices, merge the first two, then merge that result with the third backup.
help.faq.conflict.q: What happens when the same note is different on two devices?
help.faq.conflict.a: By default, both versions are kept and concatenated with device labels. You can change this in the merge settings to keep only the newest version or prefer one device.
